title: Zacess Profile
description: An accessibility profile: what a person needs, plus an optional palette. Spec version 1. See SPEC.md beside this file.

spec_version.description: The spec version the profile is written to.

name.description: The name shown to the person. One line with at least one character that is not white space and no control characters.

id.description: File name stem for rendered files. The name in lowercase with dashes when missing.

description.description: One sentence on who the profile is for.

appearance.description: Whether the background is dark or light. Worked out from the background when missing.

needs.description: What the person needs. Every field is optional.

reduce_motion.description: No blinking, animation or smooth scrolling.

cursor_size.description: Large and extra large ask for a block cursor. Where only a bar is offered, the bar is two or three times the standard width.

focus_ring_width_px.description: The width of the keyboard focus outline in CSS pixels, for apps that can set it.

line_spacing.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size.

character_spacing.description: Extra space between letters as a fraction of the font size.

column_width.description: The longest comfortable line in characters, shown as a ruler.

single_column.description: One column with nothing side by side. Read by apps with a layout to change.

hide_decoration.description: Hide decorative images and borders that carry no meaning. Read by apps with decoration to hide.

contrast.description: The floors every colour pair is checked against.

text.description: WCAG 2.2 ratio for text and syntax colours on every surface they are drawn on.

non_text.description: WCAG 2.2 ratio for borders, the focus ring and the selection block against the background.

overlay.description: WCAG 2.2 ratio for syntax colours over the current line and a soft selection.

terminal.description: WCAG 2.2 ratio for the sixteen terminal colours on the background.

terminal_dim.description: WCAG 2.2 ratio for the terminal slots listed in palette.terminal.dim.

highlight_distance.description: The smallest OKLab distance between the current line or a soft selection and the background.

apca.description: An optional APCA floor, as an absolute Lc value, checked on top of the WCAG ratio for text on the background.

family.description: A font family name with no quotes, backslashes or control characters. Empty or missing leaves each app on its own font.

fallback.description: The generic family to use when the font is not installed.

palette.description: Any colour left out is derived to meet the needs.

background.description: The main background every other colour is measured on.

surface.description: Panels, bars, sidebars and floating windows.

muted.description: Secondary text such as line numbers and descriptions.

accent.description: The one accent: the active tab, the current search match and buttons.

focus_ring.description: The outline that shows keyboard focus.

cursor_text.description: The character under a block cursor.

selection_background.description: The selection block where the selected text takes one colour.

selection_foreground.description: Selected text on the selection block.

selection_soft.description: A background-only selection, where selected text keeps its own colours.

line_highlight.description: The band behind the current line.

keyword.description: Declarations and other keywords such as const, class and fn. Drawn bold.

control.description: Control flow such as if, return, for and import. Drawn bold.

comment.description: Comments. Drawn italic and held to the same floor as code.

ansi.description: The sixteen ANSI colours, 0 to 7 normal and 8 to 15 bright.

dim.description: Slots checked at needs.contrast.terminal_dim instead of needs.contrast.terminal.

background_slots.description: Slots programs use as a background fill, so they are not checked as text.
